verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships its own natural-language shell agent, `local-ai chat`. It answers questions, reads files and runs commands on the user's machine behind an approval gate. The product also has a built-in agent platform with MCP tool support. However, no evidence shows natural-language commands being used to operate LocalAI itself, such as installing models, configuring backends or managing nodes; the agent is described only as a general shell assistant. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of LocalAI's own management functions (model gallery, config, users), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the chat agent.
